summary: Defined the mandatory certification ladder for upgrading governed engines to C4 status. Established the certification requirements registry, registered target tools for MSV-001, and implemented the certification gate script and governance guardrails.

operations_summary.notes: Removed duplicate repair and path-guessing rules from the meta section.

charter_compliance_check.notes: The C4 certification requirements correctly enforce engine-level rigor by mandating scientific validity, falsification, and uncertainty quantification before empirical results can support formal theorem promotion.
